properties.text: Press [color=#e2b27e]\[Space][/color] to activate the pressure plate

[color=#6db9f2]Objective[/color]
Guide the worker to his toolbox by solving the rotating platforms puzzle.

[color=#6db9f2]Controls[/color]
[color=#e2b27e]\[Left][/color]/[color=#e2b27e]\[Right][/color]: move around
[color=#e2b27e]\[Up][/color]: climb ladders
[color=#e2b27e]\[Down][/color]: cross bridges
[color=#e2b27e]\[Space][/color]: activate pressure plates

Press [color=#e2b27e]\[Space][/color] to start...
